objective: Phase 7: Harden chain integrity, payload realism, and load behavior
acceptance_criteria: src/xproto/provenance_token.py binds tokens to issuer, audience, task_hash, parent_token_hash, capability, nonce, expiry, and content_hash with per-hop Ed25519 signing
src/xproto/provenance_token.py detects and rejects token replay, reordering, truncation, substitution, wrong audience, expired tokens, and broken parent links
Tool-derived text remains classified as data, ensuring valid cryptographic signatures never grant tool-output independent authority
src/xproto/topology.py supports configurable maximum delegation depth with topologies of lengths 1, 2, 3, 5, and 8, as well as cycles, repeated principals, and mixed trust hops
scenarios/multihop.json defines test cases covering chain lengths 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, cycles, and mixed-trust topologies
scenarios/payload_diversity.json defines direct, indirect, obfuscated, multilingual, structured/table, and tool-error injection payloads
scripts/profile_load.py measures concurrency at 1, 8, and 32, recording throughput, p50/p95/p99 latency, and component cost breakdown (planner, transport, tool, signature, policy)
tests/test_token_integrity.py and tests/test_topologies.py verify cryptographic token binding, tamper resistance, and topology execution
non_goals: Do not package the final Phase 8 reproduction bundle or README publication report yet
